question: Which of the following is mainly observed by the Christian community?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Good Friday**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Good Friday** is a significant day observed by the **Christian community** worldwide.
 
• It commemorates the **crucifixion of Jesus Christ** and his death at Calvary, as described in the **New Testament**.
 
• Good Friday occurs during **Holy Week** on the Friday before Easter Sunday and is a part of the **Paschal Triduum**.
